items.title: ArXiv: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
items.summary: TideCache is a serving system for CPU-GPU superchips that manages heterogeneous caches and streams layers for hybrid LLMs using a transparent cache pool, cache streamer, and request scheduler. It is implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 hardware.
items.why_it_matters: The system completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20–59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40–3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.
items.next_step_detail: Download the PDF and review the architecture section to assess integration with your current inference stack.

items.title: Valkey kills the skiplist, cuts sorted set overhead by up to 43%

items.why_it_matters: Lower memory usage and faster sorted‑set operations can improve the performance of agent state stores and queue back‑ends in production systems.
